boottest

施加原假设的野生聚类自助法：rademacher权重

Stata 

boottest treat, cluster(group) reps(199) weighttype(rademacher) seed(128)

R fwildclusterboot 

fwildclusterboot::boottest(fit, param = "treat", clustid = "group", B = 199, type = "rademacher", impose_null = TRUE, conf_int = FALSE, engine = "R-lean")

与 Stata 有差异 固定流程；请明确调整示例列名。较少重复次数仅供可执行示范；须统一自助法类型、聚类和有限样本修正。软件首次报告随机种子行为变更警告；R及dqrng随机数均已设种子。 fwildclusterboot 0.13 改变了随机数种子机制，不应预期相同种子与旧版本结果完全一致。

cem

分类协变量的粗化精确匹配

Stata 

cem category (#0), treatment(treat)

R MatchIt 

MatchIt::matchit(treat ~ category, data = transform(data, category = as.integer(category) - 1L), method = "cem", estimand = "ATT", cutpoints = list(category = 0))

固定流程；请明确调整示例列名。仅进行匹配预处理；分类水平不需要连续切点。连续变量须明确统一切点和目标估计量，不能依赖不同软件默认值。

Stata 参考 · R 参考

drdid

两期面板双重稳健DiD ATT点估计

Stata 

drdid y x, ivar(id) time(time) treatment(treated) dripw

R DRDID 

DRDID::drdid(yname = "y", tname = "time", idname = "id", dname = "treated", xformla = ~x, data = data, panel = TRUE, boot = FALSE, inffunc = TRUE, estMethod = "trad", trim.level = 1)

长格式数据：每个id恰有两个时期，处理组指标treated与基期x不随时间变化。DRDID返回ATT及解析影响函数标准误。trad为dripw指定logit ML和OLS；归一化IPW对应stdipw。trim.level=1避免静默截断高倾向得分。要求重叠、条件平行趋势及无预期。

ivreghdfe

双重吸收固定效应工具变量

Stata 

ivreghdfe y z (x = instrument), absorb(id time)

R fixest 

fixest::feols(y ~ z | id + time | x ~ instrument, data = data, vcov = "iid", nthreads = 1, ssc = fixest::ssc(K.adj = TRUE, K.fixef = "full", K.exact = TRUE, G.adj = TRUE, t.df = "conventional"), fixef.rm = "singleton")

与 Stata 有差异 吸收固定效应的2SLS，结构和工具变量回归量相同并删除单例组。ssc为iid或异方差推断计入全部固定效应，聚类推断剔除嵌套于聚类的固定效应，t参考自由度为聚类数减一。ivreghdfe自动启用small；剩余截距自由度约定可能随包版本不同。

两阶段最小二乘协方差：stata

Stata 

ivregress 2sls y w (x = z), vce(robust) small

R estimatr 

estimatr::iv_robust(y ~ x + w | z + w, data = data, se_type = "stata")

与 Stata 有差异 Stata的small请求N/(N-K)的HC1修正及t分布推断。无聚类IV中，estimatr的se_type="stata"是HC1的别名。不指定small时，ivregress vce(robust)采用HC0和正态参考分布，默认推断不同。

Stata 参考 · R 参考

teffects

IPW平均处理效应及联合估计推断

Stata 

teffects ipw (y) (treat x z)

R WeightIt 

{ data <- data[stats::complete.cases(data[c("y", "treat", "x", "z")]), , drop = FALSE]; stopifnot(is.numeric(data$treat), setequal(unique(data$treat), c(0, 1))); w <- WeightIt::weightit(treat ~ x + z, data = data, method = "glm", link = "logit", estimand = "ATE", keep.mparts = TRUE); stopifnot(all(w$ps >= 1e-5 & w$ps <= 1 - 1e-5)); summary(WeightIt::lm_weightit(y ~ treat, data = data, weightit = w, vcov = "asympt"), ci = TRUE, level = .95) }

与 Stata 有差异 数值型二元treat：0为对照、1为处理；y为连续结局；观测相互独立。使用y、treat、x、z完整案例，并要求倾向得分位于[1e-5,1-1e-5]。仅含处理指标的加权回归为饱和模型，其treat系数等于归一化加权组均值之差（ATE）。vcov="asympt"联合计入logit估计权重的不确定性；summary报告稳健z检验和正态95%置信区间。截距为目标人群的对照均值。这是IPW，未在加权结局回归中额外调整协变量。

Stata 参考 · R 参考

IPW处理组平均处理效应及联合估计推断

Stata 

teffects ipw (y) (treat x z) , atet

R WeightIt 

{ data <- data[stats::complete.cases(data[c("y", "treat", "x", "z")]), , drop = FALSE]; stopifnot(is.numeric(data$treat), setequal(unique(data$treat), c(0, 1))); w <- WeightIt::weightit(treat ~ x + z, data = data, method = "glm", link = "logit", estimand = "ATT", focal = 1, keep.mparts = TRUE); stopifnot(all(w$ps >= 1e-5 & w$ps <= 1 - 1e-5)); summary(WeightIt::lm_weightit(y ~ treat, data = data, weightit = w, vcov = "asympt"), ci = TRUE, level = .95) }

与 Stata 有差异 数值型二元treat：0为对照、1为处理；y为连续结局；观测相互独立。使用y、treat、x、z完整案例，并要求倾向得分位于[1e-5,1-1e-5]。仅含处理指标的加权回归为饱和模型，其treat系数等于归一化加权组均值之差（ATT）。vcov="asympt"联合计入logit估计权重的不确定性；summary报告稳健z检验和正态95%置信区间。截距为目标人群的对照均值。这是IPW，未在加权结局回归中额外调整协变量。
